# Security policy

femto is a set of CSS files with no scripts, so most problems are bugs rather than vulnerabilities. If you find something that could put a site using femto or its users at risk, for example CSS that leaks data or a supply-chain problem with the npm package, please report it privately instead of opening a public issue.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/leoherzog/femto/security/advisories/new) on GitHub. Include the femto version, the files involved and a reduced test case if you have one.

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of femto 3 gets fixes.
